Raja (CS): quick weekly check — flagged a few Dedicated tenants with rising queue depth and spend. pulling a short summary below. :eyes:

Raja (CS): AcmeCorp — GPU hours: 12,300 (↑18% w/w), saturation: 92% p95, avg queue depth: 9 -> 14, avg token latency +60ms, weekly spend +22%.

Emily (Eng-Infra): looking — their job profile shows many small requests with low seq len and continuous batching is off in their config. likely batching inefficiency.

Oliver (SRE): noticed a spike in enqueue time in eu-west-1 03:00-06:00 UTC. sample: `enqueue_ms p50:12 p95:210 p99:480`. Not infrastructure outage, more scheduling backlog.

Natalie (Onboarding): Acme is mid-onboarding. We sent batching suggestions last week but they haven't applied them yet. I have a call scheduled Wed 10:00 with their eng lead @mike to walk through config.

Jenna (AcctExec): Renewal for Acme is in 6 weeks. If spend/latency stays like this it's a material risk. Need a mitigation plan to present on the renewal call.

Raja (CS): proposed actions: 1) enable auto-batching suggestion for Acme (low-risk) 2) canary a prefix-KV cache tweak for their model variant 3) offer a one-month usage credit tied to SLA improvements.

Emily (Eng-Infra): canary patch ready: ```
enable_continuous_batching: true
max_batch_size: 64
batch_timeout_ms: 8
``` I'll kick off canary to 3 pods once we agree.

Oliver (SRE): I'll add a temporary alert: queue_length >= 12 sustained for 10m -> pager on-call. Also instrument enqueue_ms per-tenant to verify improvements.

Natalie (Onboarding): I'll prepare a 5-min how-to snippet and share it on the Wed call. will ping @mike with the doc link before the meeting.

Jenna (AcctExec): agreed on credits contingent on telemetry. also filing a renewal note: risk = medium. add to tracker and loop in AM.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started to 3 pods, image rdx-canary-2026-03-19, health checks passing.

Raja (CS): thanks — i'll update the account health dashboard and send a short plan to Acme after the canary stabilizes. will report back in tomorrow's sync.

Emily (Eng-Infra): quick FYI — scanning other medium tenants now; seeing similar small-request patterns in 4 other accounts. might be a product UX/SDK default we can tune.

Jenna (AcctExec): tagging for renewal: medium risk. will escalate if canary doesn't reduce spend by target.

Raja (CS): closing for now. next update in this thread after canary results. :+1:
